input.subject: FW: marmara / vera cruz
input.body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Varan Shipping - Chartering Dept. <chartering@varanshipping.com> 
Sent: Thursday, 9 May 2019 13:09
To: ETMS Management <management@etm-services.net>; chartering
<chartering@etm-services.net>
Subject: FW: marmara / vera cruz 

 Dear  sherif + mohamed

Need  a  vessel for,

1 marmara /vera  cruz
Cargo 14 pcs of Storage Tanks as per below details :
160 m3 VT Storage (10 tanks):
LxHxW 4.3m x 15.7m x4.3m - Weight 15000 kg each tank
80 m3 GMMOS Tanks (4 tanks): 
LxHxW 12.1m x 3.2m x3.2m - Weight 9000 kg each tank
4 ttl
Pc ok / ondeck ok
15/20  june
Gcn 3.75 ttl


Also     need Freight indication  for

Karasu / puero limon  or caldera
10400 mts  hrc max 20 tons
Liner out
June dates

Regards
Serkan Varan 

 



 



-- 
This email has been checked for viruses by AVG antivirus software.
www.avg.com

cargo_description.value: 14 pieces of Storage Tanks: 10 x 160m3 VT Storage Tanks (LxHxW 4.3m x 15.7m x 4.3m, 15,000 kg each) and 4 x 80m3 GMMOS Tanks (LxHxW 12.1m x 3.2m x 3.2m, 9,000 kg each). On-deck stowage acceptable.
